body.name: Nested KDE and Monge--Ampere plug-in
body.construction: Compute \(\widehat p=\operatorname{OT}(\widehat P_{C0},\widehat P_{C1})\), select \(\operatorname{Lift}_{\mathbb T}(\widehat p)=(\widehat a_p,\widehat\phi_p,\widetilde{\widehat p})\), form \(\widehat q=\widehat p\#\widehat P_{T0}\) through \(\widehat f_q(z)=\widehat f_{C1}(z)(\widehat f_{T0}/\widehat f_{C0})(\widehat p^{-1}(z))\), compute \(\widehat T=\operatorname{OT}(\widehat P_{T1},\widehat q)\), select \(\operatorname{Lift}_{\mathbb T}(\widehat T)=(\widehat a_T,\widehat\phi_T,\widetilde{\widehat T})\), and return \(\widehat\tau=(-\widehat a_T-\nabla\widehat\phi_T(\widetilde y_j))_{j=1}^J\). The half-open-cell selector is used on its regular domain and the fixed Borel fallback from \(\operatorname{Lift}_{\mathbb T}\) otherwise.
